brief.headline: Push from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the market fair-band typical — to save ₹22718 a year

priceAsk.summary: Ask UFLEX to match ₹250.00/KG for the LAMINATE SKU
priceAsk.basis: Silk Polypack already sells us this laminate at ₹250.00/KG, and the market typical for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits at ₹250/kg (top of the ₹205–305/kg fair band). UFLEX's ₹385.00/KG is 54.0% above that, costing us an extra ₹22718 each year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 60 Days After Receipt to 30 days

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX publishes no financials, so we cannot see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹64788 annual spend is small for a large listed flexibles group, meaning we have limited pull on relationship alone. Because their finances aren't public, we lean on our own data: Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG and the market band prove the current price is high. The plan is to line up Huhtamaki (already a tiny FDC supplier, proven and scalable) as a ready second source, then push hard on price and terms using that competitive pressure.

evidence.point: UFLEX charges ₹385.00/KG for the LAMINATE SKU
Silk Polypack sells us the same laminate at ₹250.00/KG
The gap between UFLEX and Silk Polypack is 54.0%
This gap costs us ₹22718 every year
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate typically sits at ₹250/kg, within a ₹205–305/kg fair band
Shifting payment from 60 days to 30 days frees up ₹5325 in cash for us

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, specialises in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source option (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health score D 31/100)

risks: UFLEX is a large listed group; our ₹64788 annual spend is tiny to them, so relationship leverage is weak — lead with competitive pressure from Silk Polypack and Huhtamaki, not volume promises
No public financials means we cannot gauge their cash tightness or distress — if they walk away from a tough ask, we have no early-warning signal; keep Huhtamaki and Constantia Parikh warm as backups
The ₹22718 annual excess is material to us but small in absolute terms — frame the ask around fairness (market band, peer price) rather than the rupee saving alone

Silk Polypack already gives us ₹250.00/KG, so UFLEX knows a competitor undercuts them — be ready for pushback that Silk's quality or lead-time differs; insist on a trial batch at ₹250.00/KG to prove equivalence
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹385 per kilo for laminate that Silk Polypack sells us at ₹250 and the market pegs at ₹250 typical — let's talk about closing that 54% gap and tightening terms to 30 days so this partnership makes sense for both of us.
